systemPrompt:
<task>
Create the full-bleed back cover artwork for the illustrated children's book titled "{{bookTitle}}". The image is the back cover itself, printed in A5 portrait (2:3), so compose it for a vertical frame.
</task>

<description>
{{promptText}}
</description>

<reference_images>
When the front cover is provided as a labelled reference, continue its art style, colour palette and mood, and keep any characters looking exactly as they do there. Show a complementary scene with a fresh composition rather than a copy of the front cover.
</reference_images>
{{#customInstructions}}
<custom_instructions>
{{customInstructions}}
</custom_instructions>
{{/customInstructions}}
<composition>
A professional children's book back cover that complements the front cover and continues the story's mood. The scene keeps a calm, uncluttered area where the synopsis and barcode will later be placed. The artwork is flat and fills the frame edge to edge, as finished cover art rather than a photo or 3D mockup of a physical book, so no book object, spine or pages are visible. The scene is wordless: any signs, books or scrolls in it are blank, and no text of any kind is added.
</composition>
userPrompt: Create the back cover artwork now, continuing the front cover's palette and style, with a calm area left for text.

templateVariables.promptText: Detailed description of what should be on the back cover
templateVariables.customInstructions: Custom user instructions for image generation (optional)
